prompt: What problem did the man report at first?
promptZh: 男子一開始反映什麼問題？

options.text: His toes pressed against the front of the shoes.
options.whyZh: 男子說鞋頭感覺沒問題。

options.text: The laces were too short to tie.
options.whyZh: 店員建議改穿孔位置，沒有說鞋帶太短。

options.text: His heels lifted when he walked.
options.zh: 走路時腳跟會抬離鞋底。
options.whyZh: 男子明說走路時 his heels lift。

options.text: The shoes slipped on the ramp surface.
options.whyZh: 問題是腳跟在鞋內抬起，不是鞋底在地面打滑。

explanationZh: 男子明說走路時 his heels lift。
evidence: These walking shoes feel fine at the toes, but my heels lift when I walk. Should I try a smaller size?

vocabulary.note: 在試鞋情境指腳跟離開鞋內底，不一定是鞋在地面打滑。
